Expectation.description: One kind key (decision, event, llm, logs, message, order, policy, probe, proposal, web, workflow) and optional id and modifiers.

config.description: Partial gateway config merged over the profile.

workspace.description: Path under the workspace to file content.

accounts.description: Venues (binance, okx) that get a placeholder account; never a credential.

venue.description: Venue of the symbol; must match the account.

model.description: Market op that sets the symbol up (set by default).

MarketInit.description: Starting price model; every other key is the model op's argument (price, vol, seed, ...).

at.description: Offset from clock.start, such as +5m. Timeline only; offsets must not decrease.

Step.description: One kind key (chat, market.path, advance, ...) and an optional at.

scenario.description: Scenario id: lower-case letters or digits, then . _ - allowed; also the file name without .yaml.

covers.description: Review IDs or features this scenario covers (H8, S116A-1).

status.description: active (default) gates; known_bug documents an unfixed defect and runs only with KQ_SCENARIO_KNOWN_BUGS=1.

known_bug.description: Review ID of the open defect; required with status known_bug and refused otherwise.

llm.description: scripted (default; the only mode for PR CI), replay (a committed cassette) or live (nightly).

miss.description: llm: replay only. A request the cassette lacks fails (error) or goes to llm_script (scripted).

level.description: wire (default) or event; recorded only in v1.

pass_rate.description: Share of runs that must pass, 0 to 1 (default 1).

matrix.description: Name to values; the file runs once per combination.

base.description: Informative: the base the scenario was written against.

clock.description: The instance clock; a scenario controls it.

instance.description: Merged over the sandbox profile before the instance starts.

profile.description: Proactive profile (time zone, active hours), applied through call_tool.

market.description: Symbol to starting price model. The venue must match the account.

account.description: venue or venue/account to its simulated balances and positions.

faults.description: Fault rules, each the arguments of sandbox_fault add.

web.description: Fake web pages, each the arguments of sandbox_web put.

llm_script.description: Scripted model rules (match, respond) for llm: scripted.

setup.description: Steps that run before the clock moves (no at).

timeline.description: Steps over sim time; at offsets must not decrease.

expect.description: What the journal must show afterwards; at least one.
